verdict.rationale: Slate is a coding agent, so this debugging workflow applies to it. The evidence gives only indirect support: it can run shell commands directly (useful for reproducing issues), claims it can perform integration tests manually (a way to verify fixes), and offers parallel deep-research programs that could help investigate a problem. Nothing documents an actual reproduce, isolate, and verify debugging loop. Missing for 10: explicit debugging or root-cause workflow docs, test-running and fix-verification documentation, hands-on or independent evidence of bug reproduction and fix validation.
